meta.title: Cinema City Website Redesign
meta.project_name: Responsive cinema discovery and demo ticket-booking website

overview.client_request: Create a build-ready Cinema City Israel website specification that a lower-cost model can implement without inventing key decisions.

deliverables: Deliver website-build-spec.md and deterministic fixture-data.json for the complete Hebrew RTL prototype.
Define the visual system, routes, booking flow, responsive and accessibility states, data, tests, and production boundaries.
workflow: Read the handoff and fixtures, then build the repository, shell, routes, and booking flow in the specified order.
Run build, lint, tests, accessibility checks, and responsive screenshot review before handoff.
assumptions: Cinema City Israel is the intended brand; the first build uses local fixtures, research image references, sample inventory, and simulated payment.
acceptance_criteria: The handoff defines the complete UI and build contract; fixtures cover eight cinemas, eight movies, screenings, seat maps, experiences, and a retrievable order.

review_items: Confirm Cinema City Israel, the frontend scope, The Lobby Starts Here visual direction, routes, and production boundaries.
